purpose.text: Change log that records which row of which table was inserted, updated or deleted, when and by which database login. Triggers on hr.Employees and sales.Orders write to it.

recordMeaning.text: One row is one recorded change to one row of another table: the table name, that row's number, the kind of change, the time and the database login.

meaning.text: Sequence number of the log entry, generated by the database starting at 1; it is not declared as a key.
Schema and name of the table whose row changed, such as sales.Orders or hr.Employees.
Number of the changed row in the table named in TableName, for example an order or employee number.
Kind of change: I for insert, U for update, D for delete.
When the change was recorded, to the millisecond, in UTC by default.
Database login that made the change, filled automatically; it can identify a person even though the export does not classify it as sensitive.

businessRules.text: Every entry names a table, a row number and an action that is I, U or D; time and login are filled automatically when not given.
Entries are written only by the triggers on hr.Employees (updates and deletes) and sales.Orders (inserts, updates and deletes), and are meant never to be changed.
RecordId must always be read together with TableName, because order numbers and employee numbers come from separate counters and can overlap.
